content.text: Summary: Checked the ticket and the queues namespace. events-broker-0 is unschedulable because its PVC is bound to a PV in us-east-1a while the pod is pinned to us-east-1b (classic volume node affinity conflict from an Immediate-binding StorageClass). Since the StatefulSet is brand new with no data, I resolved the ticket advising the owner to delete the pod+PVC so they get re-created, and to switch to a StorageClass with `volumeBindingMode: WaitForFirstConsumer` (optionally with `allowedTopologies`) to prevent recurrence.
